title: Network Engineer
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

As a Network Engineer, you'll manage network services across Monks' global offices, with a primary focus on APAC. Based in Kuala Lumpur and working as part of a global team, you'll lead regional network transformation, support reliable day-to-day operations, and manage projects independently with minimal supervision.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and collaborative, takes ownership of their work, and seeks opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Lead network transformation initiatives across APAC, delivering upgrades and scalable network architecture.
* Manage tasks and projects independently, from planning through deployment.
* Administer Internet connectivity, LANs, dynamic routing, VPNs, firewalls, and Wi-Fi across Monks' global sites.
* Resolve network incidents within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), communicating clearly throughout.
* Maintain and administer network assets from our Kuala Lumpur office.
* Plan and deploy network changes, proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
* Automate routine operational and maintenance tasks.
* Monitor, analyze, and report on network service performance.

**About You**
-------------

### **The essentials:**

* Proven experience as a mid to senior Network Engineer, with the ability to drive regional network initiatives independently.
* A proactive approach to owning network stability, improvements, and project delivery.
* A track record of resolving network incidents within demanding SLAs.
* Relevant network and firewall certifications, preferably Fortinet NSE 4, 5, 6, 7, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience with Fortinet products, including FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiManager.
* Hands-on experience with wireless technologies, including Aruba Wireless, FortiAP, UniFi, and Extreme Networks.
* Hands-on experience with Juniper routers and switches.
* Experience with fiber optic networks at various speeds.
* Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, routing and switching, and routing protocols including OSPF and BGP.
* Strong network troubleshooting and documentation skills.
* Experience with network monitoring tools, preferably Zabbix and LibreNMS.
* Fluent spoken and written English.
* Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and time management skills.
* The ability to learn quickly, share knowledge, and adapt to new technologies.
* Self-motivation, attention to detail, and a calm, balanced approach under pressure.

### **Not a Must but a Plus:**

* Intermediate Linux experience, including an understanding of how Linux systems work.
* Knowledge of Windows operating systems and services, including Active Directory, Certificate Authority, and NPS.
* Experience with virtualization.
* Experience writing scripts for administration and automation, preferably in Python.

*At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds who are excited to contribute to our mission.*

*#LI-PP1*

*#LI-Hybrid*

**About Monks**

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger's Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek's first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show's inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group's 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

title: Generator Excitation Solutions – Senior Technical Lead
description:
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

You will lead the electrical engineering and delivery of high rating static generator excitation systems, ensuring compliance, quality, safety, manufacturability, and successful project execution.

Project Engineering:

* Lead electrical engineering for 5,000 A to 10,000 A static excitation systems from specification review to FAT, commissioning, and handover.
* Review customer specifications, generator data, field forcing requirements, protection philosophy, grid code expectations, and project scope to define a compliant solution.
* Size and select excitation transformer, rectifier bridge, thyristors or diodes, fuses, breakers, disconnectors, DC bus bars, field flashing, de-excitation, crowbar protection, cooling system, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary supplies.
* Develop and review schematics, single line diagrams, three line diagrams, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, cabinet layouts, BOMs, cable schedules, terminal plans, and system architecture documents.
* Engineer high current bus work considering current density, temperature rise, short circuit withstand, creepage, clearance, insulation coordination, ventilation, accessibility, and manufacturability.
* Define and validate AVR/FCR functions, voltage and reactive power control, limiters, protection logic, redundancy changeover, trip interfaces, alarms, and DCS/SCADA interfaces.
* Implement or review control logic based on SAMA diagrams, functional descriptions, approved narratives, and generator operating requirements.
* Prepare and review engineering deliverables, test procedures, compliance statements, deviation lists, risk registers, commissioning procedures, troubleshooting guides, and customer documentation.
* Coordinate with project management, manufacturing, quality, procurement, suppliers, panel builders, software engineers, field service teams, and customers to maintain design, material, and schedule readiness.
* Support manufacturing and quality checks covering assembly, wiring, bus bar installation, torque verification, clearance verification, cooling arrangement, FAT readiness, and nonconformance closure.
* Configure and integrate communication interfaces such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, DNP3, Ethernet networks, and plant automation interfaces.
* Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, HSE, cybersecurity, customer, and regional grid code requirements.

Field Services:

* Prepare site execution and commissioning plans in coordination with project managers, engineering teams, customers, and installation contractors.
* Lead site teams during excitation system installation, panel power-up, redundancy checks, I/O verification, loop checks, device checks, and system energization.
* Perform and support commissioning of high-current excitation systems, including AVR/FCR control checks, limiters, protection functions, interface testing, and generator performance validation.
* Troubleshoot issues related to excitation controllers, power bridges, firing circuits, field flashing, cooling systems, communication interfaces, protection devices, and auxiliary systems.
* Review and resolve installation or wiring deviations, site constraints, and commissioning punch points while maintaining safety and quality requirements.
* Modify logic, graphics, databases, parameters, and test configurations as required to meet approved customer and site requirements.
* Prepare customer-facing commissioning reports, test records, issue logs, and handover documentation, and coordinate with vendors and stakeholders for timely closure.

**Who You Are:**

You should be able to assume responsibility for the outcomes of others . Promotes a sense of urgency and establishes and enforces individual accountability in the team. You should be able to deliver messages in a clear, compelling, and concise manner. Actively listens and checks for understanding. Sets aggressive goals and has high standards. You should be consistently one of the top performers. Pursues everything with energy, drive, and the need to finish as per business needs.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Control and Instrumentation, or a related discipline.
* Eight to sixteen years of experience in generator excitation systems, static excitation equipment, power electronics, electrical panel engineering, or power generation control systems.
* Hands-on experience with medium to high current static excitation systems, preferably in the 5,000 A to 10,000 A field current range.
* Strong understanding of excitation transformer, rectifier bridge, thyristors or diodes, fuses, breakers, DC bus bars, field flashing, de-excitation, crowbar protection, cooling, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary supply selection.
* Ability to design, review, and troubleshoot schematics, single line diagrams, three line diagrams, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, cabinet layouts, terminal plans, BOMs, and cable schedules.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD or EPlan for electrical schematics, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, terminal plans, and engineering documentation.
* Working knowledge of high current bus work, thermal performance, short circuit withstand, creepage, clearance, insulation coordination, ventilation, accessibility, and manufacturing constraints.
* Good understanding of AVR/FCR operation, generator voltage and reactive power control, field forcing, limiters, protection functions, redundancy, trip interfaces, alarms, and DCS/SCADA integration.
* Working knowledge of MATLAB and PSS/E for excitation system studies, control performance analysis, generator response evaluation, and grid code related assessments.
* Experience preparing or reviewing engineering deliverables, compliance statements, test procedures, FAT/SAT documentation, commissioning procedures, troubleshooting records, and customer handover documents.

* Willingness to support factory testing, customer inspections, and site commissioning while following safety and quality requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**

* Practical expertise in generator excitation systems, including AVR/FCR control, field forcing, voltage and reactive power regulation, excitation limiters, protection logic, redundancy, and generator interfaces.
* Proven experience with high current static excitation systems from 5,000 A to 10,000 A, including power bridge design, component sizing, DC bus bar arrangement, cooling, cabinet layout, wiring, accessibility, and maintainability.
* Experience leading excitation projects through engineering, procurement support, manufacturing support, quality inspection, FAT, shipment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer handover.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing and quality requirements for high current electrical equipment, including assembly inspection, bus bar checks, torque verification, clearance verification, functional testing, punch list closure, and documentation control.
* Hands-on experience with excitation controllers, power converters, protection relays, synchronizing systems, generator interfaces, DCS/SCADA interfaces, and industrial communication protocols.
* Experience supporting FAT/SAT, first excitation, open circuit and short circuit testing, load testing, grid synchronization, disturbance troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Exposure to retrofit, modernization, grid code compliance, renewable integration, or large industrial power generation projects involving excitation or related power control systems.

description:

**Job Summary**
---------------


This role is responsible for managing and resolving advanced LAN/WAN network issues, ensuring operational stability and security for critical business functions. The individual will facilitate root cause analysis, mentor team members, and drive improvements in support processes to enhance customer satisfaction and protect organizational assets.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Troubleshoot and resolve complex LAN/WAN connectivity and performance issues using advanced network diagnostic tools, ensuring minimal business disruption.
  

2\. Implement and maintain ITIL\-aligned processes for incident, problem, and change management within LAN/WAN environments, ensuring compliance with security and data privacy standards.
  

3\. Conduct root cause analysis for escalated network incidents and execute remediation strategies to prevent recurrence and strengthen network resilience.
  

4\. Proactively monitor network infrastructure using platforms such as SolarWinds or Cisco Prime, identifying security vulnerabilities and coordinating prompt mitigation actions.
  

5\. Maintain and update comprehensive network documentation and knowledge bases, supporting efficient operations and knowledge transfer within the team.
  

6\. Mentor and deliver technical training to team members and new joiners on LAN/WAN management best practices, fostering skill development and productivity.
  

7\. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate, and secure resolution of network\-related issues, contributing to high customer satisfaction scores.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Advanced proficiency in LAN/WAN technologies, including configuration and troubleshooting of routers, switches, and firewalls (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent).
  

2\. Solid understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, VPN).
  

3\. Strong experience with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Cisco Prime).
  

4\. Indepth knowledge of ITIL processes and their application in network support operations.
  

5\. Good awareness of security best practices and data privacy standards in network environments.

2\. ITIL Foundation certification is recommended.
